description.fun: Nosepass's big red nose is a magnet that always points north, so travellers once used it as a compass, and in games where wild Pokémon roam the overworld it turns back to face north when left alone. It moves only about a centimetre a year, but in an emergency it can spin itself into the ground like a drill. Its look comes from the moai of Easter Island.
description.guide: A Rock-type Pokémon modelled on the moai of Easter Island and a compass, with a magnetic nose that points north. It evolves into Probopass when levelled up in a special magnetic field or exposed to a Thunder Stone.
description.tagline: A moai with a magnetic nose that always points north

description.fun: Probopass sports a moustache of iron sand stuck to its magnetic nose and a red cap that may echo the stone hats once set on moai. It steers three little 'Mini-Noses' around its body to attack from every side, though now and then one wanders off and never comes back. Its noses sit like a compass rose: the big one north, the small ones east, south and west.
description.guide: A Rock- and Steel-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, with an iron-sand moustache and three Mini-Noses it controls. It evolves from Nosepass in a special magnetic field or with a Thunder Stone.
description.tagline: A moustached moai with three remote-controlled Mini-Noses

otherWays: Level up, at Blush Mountain, Vast Poni Canyon, New Mauville, Route 13, Chargestone Cave or Mt. Coronet
